post.summary: Project a Dataset onto map points
post.description: Returns one map point per row with valid coordinates (body dataset, latCol, lonCol, optional entityCol, entityIdCol, kindCol, timeCol, attrCols, limit), plus truncated and the count of skipped rows. No capability gate. 422 when dataset or a coordinate column is missing or a column is not a safe identifier; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Project a Dataset onto map routes
post.description: Folds origin-to-destination rows into points and routes deduplicated per (origin, destination, kind) with a summed weight (body dataset, fromLatCol, fromLonCol, toLatCol, toLonCol, optional fromCol, toCol, kindCol, limit). No capability gate. 422 when dataset or a coordinate column is missing or a column is not a safe identifier; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Fold a Dataset into distinct links (compact edge rows)
post.description: PERF-P10-1 (2026-11-12): answered as application/vnd.inspecto.la-edges.v2+json - column names once and each folded link as an array; this REPLACED the per-row object shape (no compatibility shape is served). ETag / If-None-Match revalidation answers 304 with no body. An error is plain application/json. A Dataset the caller may not view is 404 (R3).

masking.description: DR-D2: the Space's masking mode, whether this read masked its ids, and why.

columns.description: Named once: source, target, kind, count, then total when the request named measureCol, then the attrCols.

attrCols.description: The trailing attribute columns of each row, in order.

rows.description: One array per folded link, in columns order, heaviest first. Masked ids are masked:<hex> aliases.

columnTypes.description: LA-17 D-M6: column -> {id, normaliser} of the Entity Type typing it.

source.description: neighbors only: where the read was answered from (index or dataset).

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match tag still matches (PERF-P4-2).

post.summary: One entity's one-hop links (compact edge rows)
post.description: PERF-P10-1 (2026-11-12): answered as application/vnd.inspecto.la-edges.v2+json - column names once and each folded link as an array; this REPLACED the per-row object shape (no compatibility shape is served). ETag / If-None-Match revalidation answers 304 with no body. An error is plain application/json. A Dataset the caller may not view is 404 (R3). With list:true the answer is a page of neighbours as application/json, not this shape.

masking.description: DR-D2: the Space's masking mode, whether this read masked its ids, and why.

columns.description: Named once: source, target, kind, count, then total when the request named measureCol, then the attrCols.

attrCols.description: The trailing attribute columns of each row, in order.

rows.description: One array per folded link, in columns order, heaviest first. Masked ids are masked:<hex> aliases.

columnTypes.description: LA-17 D-M6: column -> {id, normaliser} of the Entity Type typing it.

source.description: neighbors only: where the read was answered from (index or dataset).

304.description: Not modified: the If-None-Match tag still matches (PERF-P4-2).

post.summary: Grow preview for the explorer: what one neighbours step from a set of entities would add
post.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 GE-3 / GE-10. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, attrCols?, ids[] (or value: one id, the neighbours read's body), drawn? [values already on the explorer graph], direction? (either|out|in|reciprocal), linkKinds?, hubThreshold?, excludeBy? [listIds], filter?, limit?}. Read-only and unrecorded; available on Basic. addsNodes = distinct neighbours outside ids and drawn not removed by a list; addsLinks = their links to ids folded per (source, target, kind, attrCols) as the neighbours read folds them; linksWithinGraph = the step's links whose both ends are already on the graph (between ids, or to drawn), which the explorer adds where its graph does not draw them yet; held = those with more distinct contacts than hubThreshold (default the Space hub_threshold). limit caps the neighbours read; truncated then makes the counts lower bounds. Ids are exploration aliases when the Space masks.

200.description: Envelope data: the preview (readPath flat), plus hubThreshold, linksWithinGraph and masking.

addsNodes.description: Entities the step would add (null when needsApproval).

addsLinks.description: Links the step would add (null when needsApproval).

held.description: Busy numbers (more distinct contacts than the hub threshold) the step would hold - ids masked as the step would mask them.

excludedByLists.description: Per exclusion list, the nodes it removes from this step; removed is rounded (nearest 5, never below 5, 0 stays 0) unless the list is open.

reason.description: Why the flat Dataset answered, or why nothing was read.

403.description: A sensitive read above the Space four-eyes thresholds.

404.description: Unknown Dataset or Entity List, or a Dataset the caller may not view.

409.description: A named Entity List is retired.

422.description: A malformed field or an unknown column.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Project entities across several Datasets
post.description: Runs node mappings and edge projections over several Datasets in one call (body nodes, edges, optional filter, limit per mapping) and returns their union, each node and edge tagged with its provenance Dataset. No capability gate. 422 when neither nodes nor edges is given, there are too many mappings or an identifier or filter is invalid; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Simple paths from a start node, walked server-side (from the edge index when it can answer exactly)
post.description: LA-11 / D-3 step 5. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, startNode, targetNode?, maxDepth?, direction?, weightCol?, temporalConstraint?, filter?, maxEdgeYield?, limit?}. Answers {paths:[{nodes,hops,weight}], truncated, edgeYieldCapped, fences, source}. `source` says where the answer came from: {kind:'index', version, stale, staleReason?, fingerprint} when it was read from the Dataset's edge index (on unless the Space sets index.enabled: false; needs a published index for exactly the request's columns, maxDepth <= 2 and at most 20 distinct frontier keys per level); otherwise {kind:'dataset', reason, details?} with reason one of index_disabled, no_index, mapping_not_indexed, column_not_indexed, time_zone_not_servable, filter_not_indexed, index_stale_refused, depth_over_index_cap, frontier_over_index_cap, index_read_failed - the unchanged flat read answered. A frontier found over the cap mid-walk discards the partial index answer and re-answers whole from the flat Dataset. The base-Dataset view gate runs first (a Dataset the caller cannot view is the same 404 whether or not an index exists).

200.description: Envelope data {paths, truncated, edgeYieldCapped, fences, source}.

stale.description: kind=index: the index is served but flagged (e.g. built with another DuckDB version).

staleReason.description: kind=index: why it is out of date, in plain words, e.g. '2 files were added to the Dataset after the index was built' (the index misses the new rows).

fingerprint.description: kind=index: unknown = the Dataset's input files cannot be listed (view-backed, too many files), so currency is not knowable.

details.description: kind=dataset with reason index_stale_refused: what changed (removed or replaced input file, relation SQL, bucket function).

reason.description: kind=dataset: why the flat Dataset answered.

403.description: A sensitive read above the Space's four-eyes thresholds (the same refusal on either path).

404.description: Unknown Dataset, or one the caller may not view.

422.description: A malformed field or an unknown column.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.description: Infers entity-projection mappings by naming convention: each <base>_id column is linked to the Dataset named <base> on its id column (high confidence) or a same-named column (medium); Datasets that cannot be probed are skipped and counted. No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Reference Dataset rows for at most 500 entity keys, masked under the Space's maskingMode
post.description: Body {dataset, keyCol, keys[1..500], columns?, investigationId?, reveal?, reason?} -> {dataset, keyCol, columns, rows:[{key, row}], matchedKeys, unresolved (unknown aliases), rawKeysRefused, truncated, masking}. Keys may be aliases/pseudonyms (resolved server-side); under masking a raw key names nothing. A masked key masks its row's text and date values with it (numbers and flags pass; under all, integral values too), and the key column reads the alias asked with. reveal:true with a reason reads the named Investigation's pseudonyms raw: canRevealLinkEntities and the Investigation's lead only, one LINK_ENTITY_REVEALED audit row per entity read. Gates: 503 write root, 422 body/columns (reveal without investigationId or reason), 413 > 500 keys, 403 reveal without canRevealLinkEntities, 404/403 Investigation, 404 Dataset not viewable.

post.summary: The Incidents and Cases referencing one Entity, for a key that may be a masking alias
post.description: Body {key, entityType?, investigationId?, status?: open|closed|all, limit?: 1..200} -> {entityType, resolved, reason?, objects:[{kind, id, title, status, severity?, createdAt, matchedOn, via?}], total, truncated, masking:{mode, masked}}. The key (alias, Investigation pseudonym or raw id) is resolved server-side with the /inv/reference-rows rules: an alias only for an Entity Type the masking covers; under that masking a raw key names nothing (resolved=false, no oracle). The Entity Type is, for an alias key, entityType when given (one of the Space's Entity Types in force, else 422; ignored for a raw key), else the Investigation's endpoint type, else msisdn. Same matching and visibility as GET /objects/by-entity; no key is echoed and titles are re-masked. Gates: 503 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE on Basic (Case history is Standard and up, the investigations edition feature; answered at dispatch), 503 write root, 503 Case management not installed, 422 body, 404/403 Investigation, 422 unsearchable key.

post.summary: Profile value overlap between Dataset columns
post.description: Estimates the distinct-value overlap of column pairs across different Datasets (body optional datasets, columns, limit on pairs measured) and reports pairsConsidered and truncated. No capability gate. 404 for a named Dataset that is unknown or not viewable; 422 for a column that no profiled Dataset has or an unsafe name; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Seal a Link Analysis evidence snapshot
post.description: Stores the graph snapshot body as given (id, manifestHash, nodes, edges and the rest); a sealed snapshot is never replaced. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing or unsafe id or a missing manifestHash; 403 when the id escapes the snapshot directory; 409 when the id already exists; 500 when the body cannot be serialised; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns sealed evidence snapshot ids, newest first, with the true total and a truncated flag; query limit defaults to and is clamped by the Space's snapshot page limits. No capability gate. 422 when limit is not an integer; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Attach a sealed snapshot to a Case
post.description: Records that a sealed snapshot (body snapshotId) is attached to a Case (body caseId) in a separate log, never reopening the snapshot; returns the snapshot's attachments. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a bad snapshotId or a missing caseId; 404 for an unknown snapshot or a Case the caller cannot see; 503 when the control plane is read-only or Case management is not installed.

post.summary: Create an Investigation
post.description: Creates an Investigation over a Dataset (body purpose, dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, optional id, title, linkKindCol, timeCol, timeColZone, eventsCol, caseRef); the Space's auto-applied category lists become its first steps. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing or unsafe field or a column the Dataset lacks; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 409 when the id is taken; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: The Investigations the caller may read, newest first, paged by limit and offset. Answers {items, total, offset, limit, truncated}; each item {id, title, dataset, owner, ownerName?, createdAt, headStep, caseRef?, access, readOnly}, the title masked per the Space's maskingMode. ownerName (T-186, additive) is the owner's display name as recorded when the Investigation was created, forked or instantiated, masked as the title; an older Investigation without one names only the caller's own (from the signed-in Subject) and is absent otherwise, so a client shows the owner login id.

post.summary: Append a step to an Investigation
post.description: Appends one op from the closed vocabulary (seed, expand, exclude, hide, keep, window, annotate and others; body op plus its params) to the main log, sealing what it read. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 when op is missing, outside the vocabulary or its params are invalid; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 403 for a member who is not a lead; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Unsaved Investigation preview: the Working Set its seed / expand / exclude steps would build (stores nothing)
post.description: LA-UNSAVED-INVESTIGATION-1. Body = the binding a create takes (dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, eventsCol?, entityType? / sourceType? / targetType?) and steps[], the seed / expand / exclude bodies the step route would append, in order (1 to 4 seeds and expands plus at most 32 excludes: the Studio sends the Working Set as one seed, the unsaved Clean up excludes with their reasons and the next degree, never the history); an exclude (LA-INVESTIGATE-UX-2) drops its entities and keeps them out of every later expand, as on a saved Investigation (a merged exclude is 422: no resolve is in force); the expands read at most investigation.expand_budget_max rows in total (else 422). Each step is validated, read and evaluated by the same code as an append (bindings, frontier, four-eyes, the expand read with its budget, fan-out, hub threshold, direction, window and link kinds), so the Working Set equals what those steps record once saved. An expand above the four-eyes thresholds is not read: the walk stops with needsApproval. On a masked Space ids are taken ONLY as aliases its reads served (a raw value is 422, so guesses cannot be matched in bulk) and answered as aliases; each expand read is audited (LINK_EXPANDED) as the explorer's neighbours read is. Read-shaped and ungated like the explorer's neighbours reads; expensive rate class. Gates: write root 503, bad body or step 422, unknown or not-viewable Dataset 404, unknown column or bad zone 422. 503 on Basic.

items.description: A seed, expand or exclude op body, as POST /inv/investigations/{id}/ops takes it.

200.description: Envelope data: workingSet (entities, links, excluded with step and reason; no hash), steps[] ({step, op, needsApproval, admitted[]} or {step, needsApproval: true, exceeded[]}) and masked.

404.description: Unknown or not-viewable Dataset.

422.description: A bad body, step, column or zone.

503.description: No write root, or Basic (no Investigations).

post.summary: Grow preview: dry-run an expand and answer what it would add (appends nothing)
post.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 GE-3. Body = exactly the expand op body the Investigation would append (op optional, expand only): the same validation, budget, fan-out, hub threshold, direction, window, link kinds and index-or-flat read, evaluated against the Working Set, so the counts equal the delta of that expand appended right after on the same data. Seals nothing, appends nothing, emits no event. A body above the four-eyes thresholds is not read: it answers needsApproval: true with null counts and exceeded[]. Gated as the append: canManageIncidents, a lead of the Investigation (others 404 / a non-lead member 403). 503 on Basic.

addsNodes.description: Entities the step would add (null when needsApproval).

addsLinks.description: Links the step would add (null when needsApproval).

held.description: Busy numbers (more distinct contacts than the hub threshold) the step would hold - ids masked as the step would mask them.

excludedByLists.description: Per exclusion list, the nodes it removes from this step; removed is rounded (nearest 5, never below 5, 0 stays 0) unless the list is open.

reason.description: Why the flat Dataset answered, or why nothing was read.

403.description: The caller lacks canManageIncidents, or is a member but not a lead.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not visible to the caller.

422.description: The expand body is invalid (the same refusal the append gives), or nothing to expand.

503.description: No write root, or Investigations are not available in this edition (Basic).

delete.description: Delete an Investigation with its sealed log, Working Sets, Drafts, members, references, alert-rule bindings, pending records, Case link and embed grants (LA-INVESTIGATION-DELETE-1); it cannot be undone. Gated on canManageIncidents and a lead of the Investigation (a read-only Case member or a stranger reads 404). 409 CONFLICT while the Investigation is linked to an open Case or has a pending four-eyes approval. An audit event LINK_INVESTIGATION_DELETED (actor, time, id, title, steps and Drafts removed) is written first. Answers {id, deleted, steps, drafts}. 503 on a store backend that cannot delete (Postgres).

patch.description: Rename an Investigation and/or restate its purpose (LA-INVESTIGATION-RENAME-1). Body {title?, purpose?}: at least one; title non-blank and at most 200 chars; purpose non-blank and within the Space's input.purpose_length. The sealed header is never rewritten: the edit is a details record beside it, shown by every read (log header, list, embed) while an issued Dossier still verifies. Gated on canManageIncidents and a lead of the Investigation (a non-lead member 403; a stranger or an unknown id 404). An edit writes only the fields it was given, in one read-modify-write per Investigation, so two edits at once never undo each other (LA-INVESTIGATION-EDIT-HARDENING-1); an edit racing a delete answers 404. An unreadable details record is ignored with a warning (the sealed values show) and the next edit replaces it. An audit event LINK_INVESTIGATION_EDITED records the fields changed with their values before and after, masked per the Space's maskingMode. Answers {id, title, purpose, updatedBy, updatedAt}, masked per the Space's maskingMode.

403.description: No canManageIncidents, or a member who is not a lead.

404.description: No such Investigation, not readable by the caller, or deleted under the edit.

422.description: Neither field given, a blank or over-long title, or a blank or over-long purpose.

503.description: No write root, or Investigations are not available in this edition (Basic).

post.summary: Undo the latest Investigation step
post.description: Revert the newest effective step of the main log (a recorded undo entry). Optional body {undoes: step} names the step the caller means to revert (LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-UNDO-RACE-1): when another step is the newest by now - a team member's - the answer is 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION naming it and nothing is written; undoes not a whole number from 1 is 422. Without a body the newest step is undone. 409 CONFLICT when there is nothing to undo.

undoes.description: The step the caller means to undo; 409 when it is not the newest effective step.

post.summary: Fork an Investigation with its steps reordered
post.description: Creates a new Investigation whose header names this one as parent, re-applying the effective op steps in the body order (a permutation of them) and re-reading every expand; optional id and title. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 when order is missing or not a permutation of the effective steps; 409 when the fork id is taken; 404 when absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Replay an Investigation's sealed log
post.description: Re-evaluates the sealed log (to body at when given) and reports whether every step's Working Set hash still matches; with body reread, re-runs each effective expand's recorded query and reports drift. Persists nothing. No capability gate; any member may call it. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's log entries, bounded by query limit, with the true total. No capability gate; any member, or a member of a linked Case, may read it. 422 for a bad limit or unsafe id; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Reveal the masked entities on screen, with a reason, audited per entity
post.description: Body {tokens: [1..input.reveal_ids masked ids], reason (1..200 chars)} -> {id, revealed:[{token, id}], unknown, reason, masking}. A token this Investigation never issued is listed under unknown, never guessed. One LINK_ENTITY_REVEALED audit row per entity revealed, with the token and the reason, never the raw id; later responses stay masked. Gates: 403 without canRevealLinkEntities, 403 a member who is not a lead, 404 anyone else, 422 a missing or over-long token list or a missing, blank or over-200-character reason.

post.summary: Approve a pending four-eyes request
post.description: A second person approves a held sensitive expand or Draft promote, which then runs as the requester's step, sealed with the approval. Gated on canApproveLinkExpansions; a lead or reviewer where there are members. 403 without an authenticated Subject or when the requester decides their own request; 404 for an unknown request or Investigation; 409 when already decided or nothing is left to expand; 422 for an unsafe request id or a reason over 200 characters.

post.summary: Deny a pending four-eyes request
post.description: A second person denies a held sensitive expand, recording who denied it and an optional body reason; nothing is read. Gated on canApproveLinkExpansions; a lead or reviewer where the Investigation has members. 403 without an authenticated Subject or when the requester decides their own request; 404 for an unknown request or Investigation; 409 when already decided; 422 for an unsafe request id or a reason over 200 characters.

get.description: The held Link Analysis requests (sensitive expands, promotes of a Draft carrying one) across the Space's Investigations that the CALLER may decide: each Investigation is judged by the same gate approve/deny open through (membership role, R3, Advanced PDP), and the caller's own requests are never listed. Gates: canApproveLinkExpansions 403 → write root 503 → no authenticated Subject 403 → bad status/limit 422. Entity ids, titles and purposes are masked per the Space's maskingMode. Audited as LINK_EXPANSION_INBOX_READ. data: {items[{investigationId, title, dataset, purpose, requestId, kind, status, requestedBy, requestedAt, params, sensitivity, summary, draftId?, decidedBy?, decidedAt?, reason?}], total, limit, truncated, status}.

Builds the Investigation's Dossier from its sealed log (query at, snapshots, format json|steps|method|html), masked per the Space's masking mode; steps and method answer plain text, html one printable page. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a bad at, format, unsafe id or an unanchored snapshot; 404 when the Investigation or a snapshot is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Verify a Dossier manifest
post.description: Rebuilds the Dossier manifest from the store as it is now for the submitted position and snapshots (body manifest, or a whole Dossier) and names every artefact that changed, went missing or appeared. Persists nothing. No capability gate. 422 when the body is not a manifest for this Investigation or names too many snapshots; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns one page of the Working Set (query of entities|links|excluded, limit, offset, optional at step), masked per the Space's masking mode, with an ETag answering 304 when unchanged. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a bad of, offset, at or an unsafe id; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: Data coverage of an Investigation's window
get.description: Names the local calendar days of a window (query from, to, timezone, else the Investigation's latest window op) that have no rows in its bound Dataset, plus per-Collector coverage where the Consignment trail allows. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 when the Investigation has no time column, the window is unbounded or over the day cap, or the read fails; 404 when absent or not readable.

get.summary: Compare an Investigation's Working Set across two windows
get.description: Returns the entities and links present in window A only, B only and both (query aFrom, aTo, bFrom, bTo, optional timezone, at, mode presence|activity, minAbsDelta for activity), masked as the Working Set is. Persists nothing. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 when a window is missing, mode is unknown, minAbsDelta is used without activity or at is out of range; 404 when absent or not readable.

post.summary: Save an Investigation as a template
post.description: Saves the Investigation's effective log as a reusable method: seeds and windows become parameters and case-specific ops are dropped (body optional id, title, pack). Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an unsafe template id or pack, or no effective seed step; 403 when the id escapes the template store or for a non-lead member; 409 when the template id is taken; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when read-only.

get.description: Returns the template document; only its owner may read it. No capability gate. 422 for an unsafe template id; 404 when it is absent or another owner's; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Instantiate an Investigation template
post.description: Creates a new Investigation from the template, binding its seed parameters and optionally another Dataset with the same column roles (body purpose, params, optional id, title, dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol); every expand reads and seals that Dataset now. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing, empty or unknown parameter or a column the Dataset lacks; 404 for an unknown template or Dataset; 409 when the id is taken.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's optional link to a Case and what it grants the caller; a linked open Case's owner or assignee may read the Investigation. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

put.summary: Link an Investigation to a Case
put.description: Links the Investigation to a Case (body caseRef) outside its sealed header, sharing read-only access with the Case's owner and assignee while it stays open. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 when caseRef is missing or unsafe; 404 for a Case the caller cannot see, or an Investigation absent or not readable; 409 for a closed Case; 403 for a non-lead member; 503 when read-only.

delete.summary: Unlink an Investigation from its Case
delete.description: Removes the Investigation's Case link, audits the unlink and returns the link status. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 403 for a non-lead member; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: Export an Investigation's sealed Dossier bundle
get.description: Returns one portable JSON bundle holding the masked Dossier, its references and a custody block, sealed with SHA-256 over its canonical JSON (query at, snapshots); the export is audited. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read it. 422 for a bad at, unsafe id or an unanchored snapshot; 404 when the Investigation or a snapshot is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Verify a Dossier bundle
post.description: Checks a bundle's seal, its Dossier manifest root and appended references, and the custody of every artefact against the store as it is now (body a bundle, or {bundle}). Persists nothing. No capability gate. 422 when the body is not an inspecto-dossier-bundle/1 bundle or is for another Investigation; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's external references ({system, type, id, url, label}) in the order added, each marked trusted false, with the count and the Space's maximum. No capability gate; any member or linked-Case member may read them. 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Add an external reference to an Investigation
post.description: Appends one pointer to another system (body system, type, id, optional url, label); it is never fetched and grants nothing. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for a missing or invalid field or a url that is not absolute http(s) or embeds credentials; 409 for a duplicate (system, type, id) or a full list; 404 when the Investigation is absent or not readable; 503 when read-only.

get.description: Returns the Investigation's current member roles (lead, analyst, reviewer), the membership history and the caller's own role. No capability gate; any member may read it. 404 for a non-member or an absent Investigation; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Grant a role on an Investigation
post.description: Grants or changes a member's role (body subject, role lead|analyst|reviewer). Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an invalid subject or role, or when it would demote the last lead; 403 for a member who is not a lead; 404 for a non-member or absent Investigation; 409 (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION) when concurrent changes keep winning; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Revoke a member of an Investigation
post.description: Revokes a member's role (body subject) and the embed links they minted. Gated on canManageIncidents, and the caller must be a lead. 422 for an invalid subject or when it would revoke the last lead; 404 when the subject is not a member or the Investigation is absent or not readable; 403 for a non-lead member; 409 (CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION) when concurrent changes keep winning; 503 when read-only.

get.summary: List the preset queries a Dataset can answer
get.description: LA-PRESET-QUERIES-1. The presets the Space's Industry pack (domain_profile) offers - always the core set, the pack's own first - whose roles the Dataset maps. {dataset, pack, roles {from, to, kind, time, amount} (a column name or null), presets [{id, label, description, kind (aggregate|measure|graph), needs [role], params [{name, label, type (entity|number|kinds|window), default}]}]}. Roles come from the Dataset's defaultLinkMapping, else its first two columns classified as an Entity Type; kind, time and amount are found by name, type and the pack's measure_hints. A preset whose roles are not all mapped is not listed. LA-QUERY-BUILDER-1 adds columns {time [column], measure [{column, unit}]} - the role columns the query builder may name - and saved [{id, label, description, query}]: the Space presets saved from the builder (preset-query components) whose query this Dataset can answer.

200.description: The offered presets and the Dataset roles.

404.description: No such Dataset, or one the caller cannot view.

422.description: No 'dataset', or a Dataset that cannot be read.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Run one preset query over a Dataset
post.description: LA-PRESET-QUERIES-1. Body {dataset, params {name: value}}. Declarative, never free SQL: an aggregate preset groups the links by one end over the mapped roles (quoted columns, bound values); a graph preset joins the links to themselves (two_way, short_loops, newcomers, two_steps); a measure preset runs a Value Measure (quick_cash_out = timeToCashOut). Answer {preset, dataset, columns [{id, label, entity}], rows, count, truncated, masking}. Entity columns are exploration aliases when the Space masks; an entity parameter may be such an alias. At most 500 rows (the top parameter, and the Space's entity fence), under the Space's statement timeout. Read-shaped: persists nothing. Audited as LINK_PRESET_RUN.

404.description: No such Dataset (or not viewable), or no such preset in this Space's pack.

422.description: No body or dataset, a role the Dataset does not map, an unknown or bad parameter, or an alias this server never minted.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: Evaluate a value Measure over a Dataset
get.description: Runs one named value Measure over a whole Dataset and returns the entities breaching its thresholds in a window (query dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, optional linkKindCol, name, valueCol, timeCol, from and to or last, plus the Measure's thresholds); entities are masked when the Space masks them. No capability gate. 422 for a missing or unsafe query field or an invalid Measure; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Match a branching pattern over a whole Dataset
post.description: Runs a branching motif (such as structuring) over a whole Dataset (body dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, optional linkKindCol, timeCol, stages, filter, limit) and returns the matches with their legs; a refusal the browser would give is a 200 with refusal. No capability gate. 422 for a missing or unsafe field, an unknown column or a bad filter; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Scan a Dataset for burst or periodic links
post.description: Finds bursts or periodic series in each link's (or entity's) event times (body dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, timeCol, mode burst|periodicity, optional series, filter, limit, windowSeconds, minEvents, maxCv). No capability gate. 422 for a missing or unsafe field, a bad mode or series, an out-of-range number, an unknown field or column, or a bad filter; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 403 when the scan needs four-eyes approval; 503 when read-only.

get.description: Returns every identity group folded from the live identity assertions (query at, a log seq) with atSeq, headSeq and headHash; member keys are masked per the Space's masking mode. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a bad at; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Assert two Entity keys are one identity
post.description: Records an identity assertion that two typed Entity keys (body a, b as <type>:<value>, reason) are one identity, normalised with the type's normaliser; answers 201 with the assertion and the resulting group. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing reason, a malformed or masked key, a type not in force, an empty value, or two keys equal after normalising; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: Identity group of one Entity key
get.description: Returns the identity group of one typed, normalised Entity key (query key, optional at); a key in no live assertion resolves to a one-member group. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 when key is not a typed Entity key or at is invalid; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

post.summary: Import identity assertions from a mapping Dataset
post.description: Turns each distinct (aCol, bCol) row of a mapping Dataset into an identity assertion (body dataset, aCol, bCol, reason, optional aType, bType, limit); already-imported pairs are skipped, so a re-import adds nothing (200). Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing or unsafe field, equal or unknown columns, a type the columns do not support or a bad limit; 404 for an unknown or not-viewable Dataset; 403 when it needs four-eyes approval; 503 when read-only.

post.summary: Land an analyst CSV in an upload-enabled Collector's inbox
post.description: LA-ANALYST-UPLOAD-1. Raw CSV body (UTF-8), `?name=<file>.csv` (bare name, must match the Collector's file pattern), optional `replace=true`. Lands bytes only; the Collector's Pipeline parses, types, masks and quarantines. Needs canUploadData. Refusals: 503 no write root, 422 bad name / not a CSV / empty / zip-XLSX / NUL / not UTF-8, 403 path-shaped name, D-U7 four-eyes row budget, or replace=true on another analyst's waiting upload (only the uploader or canAdminister may replace), 404 unknown or non-upload Collector, 413 over upload.max_bytes or upload.daily_bytes, 409 name already in the inbox, or replace=true while a run of the Pipeline is in flight (a replace takes the run claim like delete), 429 rate limit.

201.description: Landed. Envelope data: collector, pipeline, file, bytes, sha256, replaced, landedAt.

get.summary: List the caller's uploads to a Collector with their ingest state
get.description: LA-I2-GAPS-RESIDUALS-1. The caller's own uploads (every upload for canAdminister), newest first, at most 200. Per upload: file, bytes, lines, sha256, uploader, replaced, landedAt, state (pending | ingested | quarantined | consumed), rejectedRows when the Pipeline wrote a reject ledger (counted up to 10000 rows; rejectedRowsCapped: true when it held more), quarantineReason when the whole file was quarantined. Metadata only - never a row or a header value. Needs canUploadData. 503 no write root, 404 unknown or non-upload Collector, 429 rate limit.

200.description: Envelope data: collector, total, truncated, uploads[].

get.summary: List the Collectors an analyst may upload to
get.description: LA-I2-GAPS-RESIDUALS-1. The Collectors that opted in with collector.accepts_upload (local poll Collectors): collector, pipeline, includes (the file patterns they pick up) and maxBytes (upload.max_bytes). Needs canUploadData.

delete.summary: Withdraw an upload the Collector has not picked up yet
delete.description: LA-I2-GAPS-RESIDUALS-1. Deletes the landed file and its upload record. Needs canUploadData, and the caller must be the uploader or hold canAdminister. Refusals: 503 no write root, 404 unknown Collector, no record of that file (exact name) or another analyst's upload (one answer), 409 the Collector already picked the file up (ingested, quarantined or consumed - its rows stay in the Dataset), a run of the Pipeline is in flight, or the filesystem refused.

200.description: Deleted. Envelope data: collector, file, deleted.

post.summary: Retract an identity assertion
post.description: Retracts the identity assertion at the given log seq (body reason) and returns the groups of its two keys afterwards. Gated on canManageIncidents. 422 for a missing reason or a seq that is not an integer of at least 1; 409 when no assertion is at that seq or it is already retracted; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: The graph-algorithm catalogue and run limits
get.description: LA separation D-4. The 29 server-side graph algorithms ({id, label, description, cost, inlineNodeCeiling, params[] {name, label, description, type, default, min?, max?, allowed?, allowedLabels?, maxSize?}, needsWeights, needsSource, needsTarget, needsNode, resultKind, engines[]}; `engines` lists "memory" and, for neighborhood, egoNetwork and degreeCentrality, "index"), the hard server `ceilings`, the Space's effective default `defaults` (the `graph_run` settings, clamped to the ceilings; `clamped` says so), the worker `pool`, the `inlineWaitMs` and `resultItems` {limit, default, ceiling, clamped}: the most entries any one list of a run's result carries (the Space's `graph_run.max_result_items`, clamped to the ceiling). A read: no capability.

post.summary: Start a graph run over an Investigation's Working Set
post.description: LA separation D-4. Body {investigationId, input?: "workingSet"|"index", at?, algorithm, params?, weights: "count"|"none", kinds?, budget?{maxNodes,maxEdges,timeoutMs}}. `input` defaults to "workingSet" (today's behaviour, unchanged). With "index" (D-3 step 7; needs the Space setting index.enabled and a current, fitting edge index) the body also takes dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol? (as /inv/projection/neighbors) and, for degreeCentrality only, seeds[1..20]; it runs neighborhood (hops <= 2), egoNetwork or a SEEDS-ONLY degreeCentrality from one pinned index version, at most 20 keys looked up per level, and the response carries source {kind: "index", version, stale, staleReason?, fingerprint} and input {kind: "index", estimated: true, version}. Every case the index cannot serve exactly is a 422 naming the cause (index_disabled, no_index, an unfit mapping or column, index_stale_refused, a non-native algorithm, hops > 2, seeds > 20, `at`, an Investigation that hides entities) - it never falls back to the Working Set; a walk that reaches past the cap is a BUDGET_EXCEEDED run naming it. Gated on canRunLinkGraphAnalysis. A Working Set within the algorithm's inlineNodeCeiling is waited for briefly and answered 200 with the run and its result; a larger one is a 202 with a Location to poll. A run already terminal at submit (BUDGET_EXCEEDED, or a result-cache hit) is a 200. BUDGET_EXCEEDED carries the budget, the measured consumed size and a reason - and never a `result` key. Entity ids in a result are masked per the Space's maskingMode, edge ids included.

200.description: The run, terminal (COMPLETED with its `result`; or BUDGET_EXCEEDED / CANCELLED / FAILED without one).

202.description: Accepted; poll the run at the Location header. No `result`.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not readable by the caller.

422.description: Unknown algorithm or field, a bad or missing parameter, a bad budget or `at`, an unknown `input`, or an `input: "index"` run the index cannot serve (the cause is named).

503.description: No write root, or the run queue is full (STORE_BUSY).

get.description: LA separation D-4. `?investigationId=` narrows to one Investigation (404 as a read of it would). Only the caller's own runs, and only those whose Investigation the caller can still read. Views carry no `result`.

404.description: `investigationId` names no readable Investigation.

503.description: No write root.

get.description: LA separation D-4. Status, progress ({work, fraction, known}: `fraction` is the algorithm's own live 0..1 and is meaningful only when `known` is true, else 0 means unknown; a COMPLETED run that reports one shows 1), the budget in force, what was consumed (`elapsedMs` is live while RUNNING and final at the end), `cached`,`exceeded` + `reason` (BUDGET_EXCEEDED), `failure` (FAILED, the exception class only) and, only when COMPLETED, the masked `result`. Each list in a result is cut to the Space's `max_result_items` (top of the canonical-v1 order): `result.truncated` is true when any list was cut and `result.lists.<name> = {total, returned, limit, truncated}` gives every top-level list's full count (a nested list, such as one group, appears only when cut) - a cut is never silent, and the cached result stays whole. A run another caller started, or one whose Investigation the caller can no longer read, is absent.

404.description: No such run for this caller.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Cancel a graph run
post.description: LA separation D-4. The run's starter or an administrator (canAdminister); the run ends CANCELLED at its next checkpoint (a queued run at once). No capability beyond that; the Investigation's read access is re-checked.

404.description: No such run - and the same answer when the caller is neither the starter nor an administrator, or can no longer read the run's Investigation (no existence signal).

503.description: No write root.

get.summary: List the edge/node indexes of the caller's viewable Datasets
get.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. {enabled, indexes, total}: `enabled` echoes the Space's index.enabled (default TRUE since 2026-10-10; an explicit false disables; when on, POST /inv/traversal/recursive-paths answers from a current index within the depth/frontier cap). Each index: dataset, mappingHash, mapping {sourceCol,targetCol,kindCol,timeCol,timeColZone,weightCol,attrCols}, version (the CURRENT one), builtAt, builder, rows (edges per direction), nodes, bytes (all tables), droppedNull (rows dropped for a NULL endpoint), tables {name: {rows, files, bytes}}, versions [{version, bytes, current}] (the retained published versions, newest first; bytes = tables + appended deltas), buckets, deltas (appended file groups the version carries), a `plan` (D-3 step 8: {recommended: none|append|full|compact, appendable, reasons, added, removed, changed + a sample of up to 20 paths each} - what differs between the version and the Dataset now and which build would close the gap; advice only, nothing is built by reading it), and `stale` + `reason` (why it is out of date, in the plain words every screen shows: the Dataset's files or its definition changed after the index was built, or it was built by another version of Inspecto or of DuckDB - an out-of-date index is still listed). Only Datasets the caller may view are walked: an index over a Dataset the caller cannot view is absent from the answer. No capability.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: List the Files recorded towards a Dataset, with each File's index state
get.description: LA-DATA-TRUST-1 S1. Query: limit (default 100, max 1000), offset, name (case-insensitive substring). One row per File from the Consignment audit trail (status ledger joined to lineage and batches of every Pipeline whose batches wrote the Dataset's stores; the problem Files of such a Pipeline are included): {name, day (event day of its output partition, null when it wrote none), rows (0 for a File read with no rows, distinct from no File), errorRows (null = not measured), ingestedAt (the Consignment commit time as a UTC ISO instant, NOT arrival time), outcome (SUCCESS | PARTIAL | QUARANTINED | FAILED, or the ledger's own word such as PARKED), collector, pipeline, consignmentId, indexState (INDEXED | WAITING | UNKNOWN | NO_INDEX | null when the File wrote no partition file), indexVersion (the live version, when INDEXED)}, newest ingested-at first. Also {assessed, total (after the name filter), offset, limit, days [{day, files, rows}], summary {files, rows, latestIngestedAt, indexed, waiting, unknown, problem} over ALL Files, index {present, version, builtAt, inputsRecorded}, readAt, note}. Index state is matched from the live IndexManifest input files (never guessed from timestamps): UNKNOWN when the manifest recorded no list (past 5000 files or an older build) or its list shares nothing with any File. assessed:false (items empty) when no audit trail attributes the Dataset - never read it as no Files. Gated by the geoLink feature, a write root, and R3 view access to the Dataset (unknown and not-viewable are the same 404). No capability.

200.description: {dataset, assessed, total, offset, limit, items, days, summary, index, readAt, note}.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: A limit or offset out of range.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: What is in one Dataset: entities, busiest, kinds of link, period, Measure totals
get.description: LA-BASIC-DISCOVER-1 (Basic and up). {dataset, computedAt, cached, rows, roles {from, to, kind, time}, entityTypes {items [{type, label, columns, distinct, approximate, masked}]}, period {column, from, to, days}, linkKinds {column, items [{kind, links}], truncated}, busiest {from [{entity, links, counterparts}], to [...], source}, measures {items [{column, unit, rows, sum, median}]}, masking}. Every section carries assessed and reason: a role the Dataset does not map, or a read that failed or ran past the Space's statement timeout, is not assessed - never a zero. Distinct entities and medians are approximate. The busiest (top 10 per end, by distinct counterparts) come from a current link index when one exists, else from the Dataset. Busiest entity ids are exploration aliases when the Space masks them. Cached until the Dataset's input files change. Gated by the geoLink feature, a write root and R3 view access to the Dataset. Audited as LINK_DATASET_DISCOVERED (no entity id).

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: A link mapping that names a column the data has not got, or a Dataset that cannot be read.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: Which Entity Types' value shapes each column of one Dataset fits
get.description: ENTITY-TYPE-RECORD-ROLES-1 (Basic and up). {dataset, sampled, columns {<column>: [{type, strong}]}}: the Entity Types whose value shape every non-empty value of the column fits, over the first 200 rows read unmasked on the server; strong when every value fits the narrow reading. Marks only, never a value. Feeds the Data page's Shape matches marks. Gated by the geoLink feature, a write root and R3 view access to the Dataset.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: A Dataset that cannot be read.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: One entity's summary over one Dataset's links
get.description: LA-ENTITY-SUMMARY-1 (Basic and up; the full Entity profile pages stay Standard, D-LAE4). Query: dataset (required). {entity {type, key, masked}, dataset, assessed, reason, links, linksOut, linksIn, counterparts, firstSeen, lastSeen, measure {column, unit, out, in} | null, counterpartsByLinks [{entity, links, out, in, amount?}] (top 20), counterpartsByAmount (top 20 by the primary Measure) | null, kinds [{kind, links, out, in}] | null, kindsTruncated, activity [{day, links}] (the 90 days before its last seen) | null, masking}. A part whose role the Dataset does not map is null. Keys are compared normalised under the Entity Type's normaliser. For a type masked under the Space's mode the key must be the exploration alias (a raw value is refused 422, never read); counterparts leave as aliases when the Space masks. A read past the Space's statement timeout answers assessed:false with why. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_SUMMARIZED, never with the key.

parameters.name: entityKey
parameters.description: A raw value (unmasked types) or an exploration alias.

404.description: No such Entity Type; no such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: No dataset; a raw key for a masked type; an alias this server never minted; a Dataset that maps no From and To.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Run one query-builder question over a Dataset
post.description: LA-QUERY-BUILDER-1 (Basic and up). Body {query {by (from|to), rank (links|counterparts|sum), sumColumn?, from?, to?, kinds?, timeColumn?, after?, before?, measureColumn?, measureMin?, measureMax?, min?, top?}}. Declarative, never free SQL: any other key is refused; timeColumn must be a Time column of the Dataset, sumColumn and measureColumn a Measure (GET /inv/presets lists them); after / before are a day or an ISO instant, a half-open window; every value is bound. Answer {dataset, query, columns [{id, label, entity}], rows, count, truncated, masking}, like a preset run. Entity columns are exploration aliases when the Space masks; from / to may be such an alias. At most top rows (500, and the Space's entity fence), under the Space's statement timeout. Read-shaped: persists nothing. Audited as LINK_QUERY_RUN. A Space preset saved from the builder is a preset-query component {label, description, query}, run through this route.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

422.description: No query; a query the Dataset's roles do not support; an unknown alias; a read past the statement timeout.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: The exclusion lists an Investigation can apply
get.description: LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-1 phase 4. Read-shaped, like the Entity List reads (Space access; every edition, Basic included). Answers {lists: [{id, title, entityType, ownerKind, autoApply, visibility, size}]}: every live (not retired) Entity List of purpose exclusion, category (ownerKind admin) lists first, then by title. Never members: a restricted list shows its size only.

503.description: No write root.

get.summary: List the Entity Types in force with their bindings and cached headline
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. {items: [{id, label, normaliser, masked, classifications, family?, definition?, example?, shape?, bindings: [{dataset, column, role}], headline: {distinct, approximate, rows, dataAsOf, computedAt, assessed, reason}}], families: [{id, label, definition}], recordTypes: [{id, label, definition, likelyTypes}]}. recordTypes are what one row of a Dataset can be, from the Space's Industry packs (ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1 P2; empty with no pack), each with the Entity Type ids such a record usually holds. family is one of the closed families (ENTITY-TYPE-CATALOG-1: party, organisation, account, identifier, device, place, document), listed in families in picker order; family, definition and example are reader guidance, and shape is the value shape from the closed vocabulary (free, e164, digits(n|a-b), luhn(n|a-b), iban, email, uuid), each absent when nothing states it. A binding is every Dataset column whose classification the type claims; role is source / target when the column is a link end of a saved Link Analysis view or a published index mapping, else attribute. The headline is the last computed type profile (cached, never a query on this request): assessed:false with reason 'not computed yet' until the type's profile has been read once. Only Datasets the caller may view are walked. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_TYPES_LISTED.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

delete.summary: Delete an Entity Type nothing uses
delete.description: LA-ENTITY-TYPE-RETIRE-1. Removes the type from the Space's stated Entity Types (link-analysis.toon); deleting one of the inherited defaults states the rest. Gated on canAuthorWorkbench (the capability that states the types through PUT /settings/link-analysis), then a write root (503), then the type in force (404). 409 CONFLICT, naming what uses it, while any registered Dataset has a column whose classification names the type (a class it claims, or its id) (every Dataset is checked; a column in a Dataset the caller cannot view is counted, not named), any live Entity List is of the type, or any Investigation's header (endpoint types), main log or open Draft names it as entityType / sourceType / targetType; also 409 for the last type in force. Answers {deleted, entityTypesInForce}. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_TYPE_DELETED.

404.description: No such Entity Type in force.

409.description: Still used by a Dataset column, a live Entity List or an Investigation, or the last type in force.

503.description: No write root, or the Link Analysis settings could not be read.

get.summary: Read the Entity Type profile: aggregates over every column bound to the type
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. Query: sections (comma list of bindings, volume, shapes, time, lineage, links, relationships, measures; all when absent), from / to (a window over the measures section only, echoed as window {from, to}). {entityType, computedAt, cached, truncated, masking {mode, masked}} plus each requested section: measures [{dataset, column, measure, unit, rows, sum, min, max, distribution {entities, p50, p90, max, sampled, every, sampleEntities, approximate (when sampled), truncated, assessed, reason}, assessed, reason}] (LA-COLUMN-ROLES-2 D-1: one row per binding x Measure of its Dataset over the rows where the bound column names an Entity, inside the window on the binding's time column - a binding with none is not assessed inside a window; a column holding an Entity Type is never a Measure; distribution = the per-Entity totals over at most entity_profile.measure_sample_entities Entities, above it a key-hash sample of 1 in every), bindings [{dataset, column, role, timeColumn, rows, nonNull, fillRate, distinct, approximate, failNormaliser, assessed, reason}], volume {distinct, approximate, rows, sentinels [{dataset, column, kind: builtin|dominant, value (null for dominant), rows, share}], assessed, reason}, shapes {length [{length, rows}], prefix [{prefix, rows}], prefixLength (e164 3, else 0), charClass {digits, letters, mixed}, sampled, assessed, reason}, time {earliest, latest, perDay [{day, rows, distinct}], missingDays, dataAsOf [{dataset, dataAsOf}], assessed, reason}, lineage [{dataset, pipelines, collectors, files, rows, latestIngestedAt, waitingForIndex, problemFiles, assessed, reason}], links {from (dataset; index once the manifest carries link statistics), kinds [{kind, edges}], degree {p50, p90, p99, max}, hubThreshold, hubs, singleLink, assessed, reason}, relationships [{otherType, dataset, oneToOneShare, maxPerEntity, threshold, entitiesAtOrAboveThreshold, assessed, reason}]. Aggregates only: never a raw identifier (a dominant value is reported without its value; hubs are counted, not named). Distinct counts are over the normalised Entity key and approximate. A section that could not be read says assessed:false with the reason; a read cut by an entity_profile.* limit says truncated:true. Cached by the bound Datasets' input-file fingerprint (a new File invalidates it). Gated like POST /inv/projection: geoLink, a write root, R3 view access per Dataset. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_TYPE_PROFILED.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Window start (ISO-8601 instant with a zone, inclusive) of the measures section; UTC, [from, to). 422 for a malformed instant, one outside 0001-01-01..9999-12-31, or from >= to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Window end (ISO-8601 instant with a zone, exclusive); see 'from'.

404.description: No such Entity Type in force.

422.description: An unknown section name, or a malformed window.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

get.summary: Read one Entity's profile by raw value or exploration alias
get.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5. For a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the key is the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>) only - a raw value is refused 422, pointing at POST /inv/entities/{type}/resolve, so a raw identifier never travels in a URL; for an unmasked type the value itself. The key is resolved through the same masking as the exploration reads, then normalised by the type's normaliser. {entity {type, key (the alias when the type is masked under the Space's maskingMode), masked}, firstSeen, lastSeen, activeDays, coveredDays, perDay [{day, rows}], where [{dataset, column, rows}], measures [{dataset, column, measure, unit, rows, sum, min, max}] (LA-COLUMN-ROLES-1: each Measure of each Dataset the Entity is in, over the rows naming it in that column, inside the window; a value that is no number is not counted), links {degree, kinds [{kind, count}], percentile, from, assessed, reason}, related [{type, count, keys (aliases when either type is masked)}], dataAsOf [{dataset, dataAsOf}], truncated, assessed, reason}. An Entity seen nowhere answers 200 with an empty where. Gated like POST /inv/projection. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_PROFILED (the key is never recorded).

parameters.name: entityKey
parameters.description: The exploration alias for a masked type; the value (URL-encoded) for an unmasked one.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Window start (ISO-8601 instant with a zone, inclusive), from an Open in Inspecto LA deep link. With 'to', scopes where, firstSeen, lastSeen, activeDays, coveredDays and perDay to the window (UTC, [from, to)) and echoes {window: {from, to}}; links and related stay whole-history. 422 for a malformed instant, one outside 0001-01-01..9999-12-31, or from >= to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Window end (ISO-8601 instant with a zone, exclusive); see 'from'.

404.description: No such Entity Type in force.

422.description: A raw value for a masked type (use the resolve route), an alias this server never minted, or a key that normalises to nothing.

503.description: No write root, or no Dataset provider.

post.summary: Resolve a raw value or an alias to the key an Entity profile URL takes
post.description: la-entity-profile-plan section 4.5 (operator 2026-10-15: a raw identifier never travels in a URL). Body {key: a raw value or an exploration alias}. Answers {type, key, masked}: for a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>) of the normalised key, else the normalised value. Reads no Dataset and persists nothing. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability. Rate-limited like the Entity profile. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_KEY_RESOLVED (the key is never recorded).

key.description: A raw value or an exploration alias.

404.description: No such Entity Type in force.

422.description: No key, a key that normalises to nothing, or an alias this server never minted.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: List the values of an Entity Type that start a graph (the Start box type-ahead)
post.description: LA-ONBOARD-1 OB-9. Body {prefix?: a raw prefix (empty or absent = every value), dataset?: one Dataset id, limit?: 1..20 (default 8), reveal?: true to list a masked type's raw values (needs canRevealLinkEntities)}. Reads only the type's link-end columns (a source or target of a mapping the Space knows: a Dataset's defaultLinkMapping, a saved view or an index) on Datasets the caller may view, optionally one Dataset's. Answers {type, masked, revealed, datasets, items [{value, links (rows naming it in a link column), firstSeen, lastSeen}], distinct (Entities matching), truncated, assessed, reason}, busiest first. A type masked under the Space's maskingMode lists no value and is counted only for an empty prefix, unless the caller sends reveal: true and holds canRevealLinkEntities (LA-ONBOARD-DEFECTS-1; revealed: true, audited). The prefix travels in the body only. Gated by the geoLink feature and a write root; no capability unless reveal is asked. Rate-limited like the Entity profile. Audited as LINK_ENTITY_SUGGESTED (the prefix and values are never recorded).

prefix.description: The start of a raw value; empty lists the busiest.

reveal.description: List a masked type's raw values; needs canRevealLinkEntities.

200.description: {type, masked, revealed, datasets, items, distinct, truncated, assessed, reason}.

404.description: No such Entity Type in force.

422.description: A prefix that is not a string or is longer than input.id_length, a blank dataset, a limit outside 1..20, or a reveal that is not a boolean.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Third-party integration (inbound): open a seeded Investigation for an external record
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 section 4, phase 5. A fraud product or case manager hands over its own record and the entities it is about. Body {reference: {system, type? (default alert), id, url?, label?}, entities: ["<type>:<key>" ...], purpose, title?, window?: {from?, to?, ...}, binding?: {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, linkKindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, eventsCol?}}. Each entity is typed by an Entity Type in force; its key is a raw value (sent in the body) or an exploration alias, normalised by the type's normaliser. Without a binding, the first saved Link Analysis view or published index that links a column of EVERY Entity Type the call names is used (its kind and time columns come along); when no single mapping covers all the named types the call is refused 422 naming them, so name one type per call or send a binding. BEHAVIOUR CHANGE for integrators: a call naming several types used to bind through the first entity's type only and seed the rest unbound; it is now refused 422 unless one mapping covers them all or a binding is sent (an explicit binding is never second-guessed). Composes the existing writes: POST /inv/investigations (purpose, R3 Dataset gate), one seed op per Entity Type, an optional window op, and an external reference (trusted:false). Idempotent on (reference.system, reference.id): the Investigation id is derived from them (ext-<32 hex>), so a repeat - or a racing duplicate on any node - answers the SAME Investigation with created:false and adds nothing. Answers {investigationId, created, seeded, reference, link: "/open?investigation=<id>" (the la-app route; the console mounts it at /studio/open), note}. Gated on canOpenInboundInvestigation (OIDC-CC-INTEGRATION-ROLE-1; seed role integration). A machine (client-credentials) caller is admitted only in a Space whose roles.toon names its client in identity.machineClients (403 elsewhere) and keeps only allowlisted capabilities; it reads the Investigations it leads. Rate-limited with the expensive Link Analysis class (429: retry, it is idempotent).

type.description: What the record is in that system (default alert).

id.description: The record's id in that system.

url.description: An absolute http(s) URL to the record; never fetched.

window.description: An Investigation window {from?, to?, ...}; needs a time column.

binding.description: The Dataset and link columns, when the Space's views and indexes do not say.

404.description: The binding's Dataset is unknown or not viewable by the caller.

409.description: This external reference already opened an Investigation the caller cannot change.

422.description: A malformed reference, entity, window or binding; an unknown Entity Type; no view or index links the entity's type; no purpose.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Validate an Open in Inspecto LA link's parameters
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 section 4 (roadmap I5). The SPA's /open page sends the link's parameters in the BODY: {entity?: "<type>:<key>", investigation?: id, window?: {from?, to?}, reveal?: boolean}. For a type masked under the Space's maskingMode the key must be the exploration alias (masked:<16 hex>): a raw value is refused 422 without being repeated (get the alias from POST /inv/entities/{type}/resolve). Answers {entity?: {type, key (alias or normalised value), masked, revealed?}, investigation?: {id, title}, window?}. reveal:true on a masked entity returns its raw value only to a holder of canRevealLinkEntities (403 otherwise), audited as LINK_ENTITY_REVEALED naming the alias. Reads no Dataset and persists nothing; no capability for the read itself.

404.description: The Investigation does not exist or the caller cannot read it (one answer).

422.description: Neither entity nor investigation; a malformed entity; an unknown Entity Type; a raw key of a masked type; an alias this server never minted; a bad window.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Start an edge/node index build over a Dataset
post.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. Body {dataset, sourceCol, targetCol, kindCol?, timeCol?, timeColZone?, weightCol?, attrCols?, mode?}. `mode` (D-3 step 8) is `full` (default; rebuild from the Dataset), `append` (add ONLY the input files added since the live version, as a delta, published as the NEXT immutable version; refused 409 when a covered file was removed, superseded or rewritten, the relation SQL or bucket function changed, nothing was added, the Dataset is not a plain row-wise store read, or the version already carries 8 deltas) or `compact` (merge the live version's deltas into one sorted main; refused 409 when it has none). Nothing appends or compacts on its own: GET /inv/index only advises. Gated on canBuildLinkIndex (a build spends compute and disk). The Dataset gate runs first, exactly as for a projection: an unknown Dataset is 404 and a Dataset the caller may not view is the SAME 404. A build whose estimate (rows x 34 bytes x 2) is above the Space's index.max_disk_bytes (0 or unset = no limit) is refused up front with the estimate in the message. One live build per (Dataset, mapping): a second start is 409. Always 202 with a Location to poll; the build runs on its own DuckDB connection and publishes an immutable version under <Space write root>/la-index.

202.description: Accepted; poll the build at the Location header. {buildId, status, dataset, mappingHash, progress, ...}.

404.description: No such Dataset, or not viewable by the caller (the same answer).

409.description: The same index (Dataset + mapping) is already building, or an `append` / `compact` is not applicable now (the message names why and the way forward).

422.description: Unknown or missing field, an unknown mode, a column the Dataset does not have, a bad time zone, or an estimate over index.max_disk_bytes.

503.description: No write root, or the build queue is full (STORE_BUSY).

get.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. Status (QUEUED, RUNNING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, FAILED), the builder's progress {phase, step, steps}, cancelRequested, `failure` (FAILED: the exception class only, never a message) and, when COMPLETED, `result` {version, rows, edges, droppedNull, nodes, buckets, bytes, totalMs}. A build another caller started, or one over a Dataset the caller can no longer view, is absent.

404.description: No such build for this caller.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Cancel an index build
post.description: LA separation D-3 step 4. The build's starter or an administrator (canAdminister); a running build is cancelled through the builder (nothing is published, the stage is deleted), a queued one at once. No capability beyond that.

404.description: No such build - and the same answer when the caller is neither the starter nor an administrator, or can no longer view the build's Dataset (no existence signal).

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Fork a Draft of an Investigation
post.description: Creates the caller's own working copy forked from the main log (body optional at step, label); one live Draft per member. Gated on canManageIncidents; a lead or analyst. 403 for a role that does not fork; 422 for a bad at or label; 409 when the member already has a live Draft, the Space is full or the id is taken; 404 for a non-member; 503 when read-only or the Draft store is busy.

get.description: Returns the caller's own Drafts of the Investigation (a lead or reviewer sees all), live ones only unless query discarded=true. No capability gate; the caller must be a member. 404 for a non-member or an absent Investigation; 422 for an unsafe id; 503 when the control plane is read-only.

Returns the Draft's header, head step and whether the main log has moved on since it forked. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member, an unknown Draft or another analyst's Draft; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

Returns the Draft's own log entries (the steps after the base it forked from). No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member, an unknown Draft or another analyst's Draft; 409 when the Draft was discarded, promoted or expired, or the main log's forked prefix changed; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

Returns one page of the Draft's Working Set (query of entities|links|excluded, limit, offset, at), served as the main Working Set route serves it. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member or an unknown or unreadable Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed or its base changed; 422 for a malformed id or bad query.

Re-folds the main prefix plus the Draft's own steps from scratch and reports any step whose recorded hash or persisted set hash no longer matches. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member or an unknown or unreadable Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed or its base changed; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

post.summary: Append a step to a Draft
post.description: Appends one op to the Draft with the same validation and sealing as the main log (body op plus its params). Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor only. 403 for a lead or reviewer who is not its actor; 404 for a non-member or an unknown Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed, its base changed or its index pin expired (rebase first); 422 for an invalid op.

post.summary: Undo the latest Draft step
post.description: Revert the newest effective step of the Draft's own ops (a recorded undo entry). Optional body {undoes: step} names the step the caller means to revert (LA-GROW-EXCLUDE-UNDO-RACE-1): when another step is the newest by now the answer is 409 CONFLICT_STALE_VERSION naming it and nothing is written; undoes not a whole number from 1 is 422. Without a body the newest step is undone. 409 CONFLICT when there is nothing to undo.

undoes.description: The step the caller means to undo; 409 when it is not the newest effective step.

post.summary: Discard a Draft
post.description: Closes the Draft with an audit marker, deletes its log and sealed sets, and releases its index pins; a repeat answers alreadyDiscarded. Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor or a lead. 403 for anyone else who can see it; 404 for a non-member or an unknown Draft; 409 when the Draft was promoted; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

get.summary: Conflicts a Draft rebase would meet
get.description: Returns the conflict report a rebase of the Draft onto the current main head would produce; writes nothing. No capability gate; the Draft's actor, or a lead or reviewer. 404 for a non-member or an unknown or unreadable Draft; 409 when the Draft is closed or its base changed; 422 for a malformed Draft id.

post.summary: Rebase a Draft onto the main head
post.description: Replays the Draft's effective ops over the current main head, re-pins index versions and swaps the result in (body optional confirm list of superseded or blocked steps, expectHead). Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor only. 409 when expectHead is not the head or a conflict is unconfirmed, or the Draft is closed; 422 for a bad confirm or expectHead; 403 for a non-actor; 404 for a non-member or unknown Draft.

post.summary: Promote a Draft into the main log
post.description: Appends the Draft's effective ops to the main log atomically (body optional expectHead); a promote carrying a sensitive expand is held as a pending four-eyes request (202). Gated on canManageIncidents; the Draft's actor or a lead. 409 when expectHead is not the head, the Draft must rebase first or is closed; 422 when it has no ops or expectHead is bad; 403 for anyone else; 404 for a non-member or unknown Draft.

get.description: Returns the caller's own Investigation templates, newest first, as summaries (id, title, pack, createdAt, dataset, investigation, and counts of parameters and ops). No capability gate. 503 when the control plane is read-only.

get.summary: List the read-only embed links of an Investigation
get.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Read-shaped: any reader of the Investigation. {investigationId, enabled, grants[], max}; each grant {grantId, label, issuedBy, issuedAt, expiresAt, status (active|expired|revoked), revokedAt?, revokedBy?, revokedReason?, lastViewAt?, viewCount}. Never a token or a token hash. Expired grants lose their hash here (the row stays).

404.description: No such Investigation, or not readable by the caller (the same answer).

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Mint a read-only embed link to an Investigation
post.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1 (operator decisions 2026-10-12). Body {ttl_hours?, label?, scope?, masking_mode?}: scope is working_set | with_notes | full (default full; the Working Set is always shown), masking_mode is none | typed | all and never looser than the Space's (422), so a link can only be stricter. Gated on canShareInvestigation (no four-eyes) and on the caller being a LEAD of the Investigation; the Advanced ABAC action `embed` can forbid it. 503 unless -Dla.embed.enabled=true. ttl_hours defaults to the Space embed.default_ttl_hours (72) and is refused with 422 above embed.max_ttl_hours (default 720 = 30 days; a Space may raise it up to 8760 = 365 days), never clamped. A frame allowlist is refused (422): links are link-only. 422 also when the Investigation reads data of a classification in the Space embed.refuse_classifications. Answers {grantId, investigationId, token, url, expiresAt, label, maskingMode, note}: the token is shown ONCE and only its SHA-256 is stored. Minting writes a sidecar, never an op-log entry: the Dossier root and the op-log hash do not move. At most 20 live links per Investigation (409).

403.description: The caller lacks canShareInvestigation, is not a lead of the Investigation, or an access policy denies the action embed.

404.description: No such Investigation, or not visible to the caller (the same answer).

409.description: The Investigation already holds 20 live links.

422.description: ttl_hours outside 1..the Space maximum, an unknown field (frame_ancestors included: framing is a Space setting, not a per-link one), a bad scope, a masking_mode looser than the Space's, a bad label, or a refused classification.

503.description: Embed links are disabled (-Dla.embed.enabled) or there is no write root.

post.summary: Revoke one embed link of an Investigation
post.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Gated on canShareInvestigation and on the caller being a LEAD of the Investigation. Immediate: the link answers the uniform 404 from the next request on; its token hash is dropped and the row stays. Idempotent. Links also revoke automatically when their minter loses their lead role, the Investigation's linked Case closes, or the Space's masking is loosened.

403.description: The caller lacks canShareInvestigation or is not a lead.

404.description: No such Investigation or link.

503.description: No write root.

post.summary: Hand an Investigation's Dossier bundle and findings off to the external case manager
post.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canManageIncidents, lead only. Body {reveal?}; ?at=&snapshots= as the bundle export. Builds the Dossier bundle (masked per the Space's maskingMode unless reveal:true by a holder of canRevealLinkEntities, then masking.mode is revealed), renders the Space's field-mapping template, and POSTs it through the platform egress (registered https Connection, egress allowlist, pinned address, no redirects, Collector retry on I/O, 5xx, 408, 429 under one Idempotency-Key). The case id at handoff.caseIdPointer of the answer is linked as an external reference {system, type case}. Answers {investigationId, delivered, system, externalCaseId, url, linked, status, attempts, masking, seal}.

403.description: Missing canManageIncidents, not a lead, or reveal without canRevealLinkEntities.

404.description: No such Investigation (or not visible).

409.description: No hand-off configured, or the reference list is full.

422.description: Refused before sending (egress denied, unusable Connection, literal token); nothing was sent.

502.description: The case manager failed after the retries, or answered without a usable case id; nothing was linked.

503.description: No write root, or outbound integration not installed.

get.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canAdminister. Answers {handoffConfigured, webhooksConfigured, installed, settings, events, placeholders, note}. settings is la-integration.json as stored: handoff {connection, system, authHeader?, template?, caseIdPointer, caseUrlPointer?}, webhooks {connection, signingSecret (a ${...} reference), events}, retry {count, backoff, initialDelayMillis, maxDelayMillis}. It never holds a secret.

put.summary: Replace the Space's third-party integration settings
put.description: LA-EDITIONS-1 phase 6. canAdminister. Gates: 403 -> write root 503 -> 422 (unknown key, a connection or system name that is not a safe name, an authHeader the transport or the signature sets, a template placeholder outside the published list, a template over 64 KiB, a signingSecret that is not a ${...} reference, an unknown event, a retry value out of range) -> atomic write. Audited as LINK_INTEGRATION_CHANGED with before/after.

422.description: Invalid settings; nothing was written.

503.description: No write root.

get.summary: Read-only embedded view of one Investigation (public; the token is the credential)
get.description: LA-EMBED-VIEW-1. Anonymous: exempt from platform authentication, authenticated by the embed token in the path; the holder is an EmbedGrant, never a Subject, so it reaches no other route. Answers the masked view {investigation{id,title,purpose,createdAt}, head{step,workingSetHash}, workingSet{entities,links,excludedCount}, annotations, references, link{expiresAt}, masking} - masked exactly as the Space masks an Investigation read (maskingMode), read from the sealed log only. EVERY failure (disabled, malformed, unknown, tampered, expired, revoked, deleted Investigation, minter no longer a lead, Case closed, masking loosened) is the same 404. GET only. Headers: Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors 'none', X-Frame-Options DENY, Cache-Control no-store, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, X-Content-Type-Options nosniff; no CORS, no cookie. Throttled per token and per IP (429). The token is redacted from every log line and audit row.

404.description: Not found (one answer for every refusal).

429.description: Rate limit exceeded for this link or this address.
